name: Generic content reading current-build native selector and browser journeys
command:
set -euo pipefail
 tauri-agent-tools eval --pid "$VERIFY_TAURI_PID" 'window.__TSR_ROUTER__?.navigate({to: "/", search: {chat: true}})'
 "$VERIFY_TAURI_POLL" --selector 'button[aria-label="Read selected text aloud"]'
 cd "$OPERATOR_SOURCE_ROOT/apps/operator"
 export OPERATOR_E2E_REUSE_SERVER=1 OPERATOR_E2E_BASE_URL="$VERIFY_TAURI_DEV_URL"
 node "$(node -p 'require.resolve("@playwright/test/cli")')" test e2e/content-reading.spec.ts --workers=1 --retries=0
summary: Maintained verifier prepare/boot/assert passed on immutable source5759cb9fc4b5be26b1a20744587554b7b8169607. Native reading-control selector passed; registered Playwright suite4/4 passed; isolated process/PG cleanup finished and managed task recorded completed exit0.

assertions.evidence: Playwright content-reading.spec.ts:80 passed: original reading preserves its final tail and pauses/resumes the same output without a microphone.
Playwright content-reading.spec.ts:119 passed: summary-only and summary-and-read keep separate consent and source coverage.
Playwright content-reading.spec.ts:155 passed: cancel summary ignores a late result and cannot start obsolete speech.
Playwright content-reading.spec.ts:175 passed: summary failure is visible and never becomes summary text or speech.

isolation.frontend: frozen SPA requiring OperatorChatSidebar.tsx and voice-mode.ts

scopeLimits: Browser assertions use controlled summary and audio adapters; real provider, model, local-only routing and long-tail synthesis are separate saved work-item evidence.
Native webview selector proves the reading controls render; it does not prove audible playback.
This is current-build implementation acceptance. It does not prove final deployed main or gateway protection.
